The first Telugu to English dictionary was composed by
x:
Charles Philip Brown (C. P. Brown) made an unparalleled contribution to the preservation and development of Telugu language and literature. During his service in the Madras Civil Service, he mastered Telugu and devoted his life to collecting, editing and publishing numerous classical Telugu works. Among his greatest achievements was the compilation of the first comprehensive Telugu–English Dictionary, which became an indispensable reference for students, scholars and administrators. Brown also prepared an English–Telugu Dictionary, edited the works of Vemana, Pothana and several other Telugu poets, and established a systematic approach to Telugu lexicography. Because of his immense contribution, C. P. Brown is remembered as one of the greatest foreign scholars of Telugu literature.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).
n: Often called the "Saviour of Telugu Literature."

s: Where is the C.P. Brown Memorial Trust Library located in Andhra Pradesh?
x:
The C.P. Brown Memorial Trust Library is situated at Kadapa in Andhra Pradesh. Charles Philip Brown (1798–1884) was a British civil servant who devoted his life to the preservation and development of Telugu language and literature. His major contributions include: • Collection and editing of Vemana Padyalu • Preparation of the first comprehensive Telugu-English Dictionary • Editing works of Pothana, Tikkana, Nannaya and other Telugu poets • Standardization of Telugu grammar and spelling. The memorial library preserves manuscripts, rare books and research materials relating to Telugu literature.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (3).
n: Famous for preserving Telugu literary heritage.

s: Which organization published the first Telugu magazine Satyadootha?
x:
Satyadootha is regarded as the first Telugu magazine. It was published by the Christian Mission at Bellary during the nineteenth century. The magazine mainly aimed to: • Spread Christian teachings • Promote literacy in Telugu • Publish educational and moral articles • Encourage printing and publication in Telugu Although missionary in character, it marked the beginning of Telugu journalism and periodical literature.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (2).
